hints.content: **Reflective (or line) symmetry** means that we can reflect a figure across a line, and the figure will remain unchanged.

##Reflection over $\overline{AF}$

Under this transformation, each point on the octagon maps to another point which is also on the octagon.


[[☃ image 1]]

The octagon is *symmetric* over this line.

options.alt: An octagon with vertices at B, C, D , E, G, H, J, and K. Side K B has a midpoint A. Side E G has a midpoint F. Sides K B, B C, C D, D E, E G, G H, H J, and J K are congruent. A blue horizontal line connects from midpoint A to midpoint F. The octagon is reflected about the line where the image lies on the pre-image.

hints.content:
##Reflection over $\overline{DJ}$

Under this transformation, each point on the octagon maps to another point which is also on the octagon.


[[☃ image 1]]

The octagon is *symmetric* over this line.

options.alt: An octagon with vertices at B, C, D , E, G, H, J, and K. Side K B has a midpoint A. Side E G has a midpoint F. Sides K B, B C, C D, D E, E G, G H, H J, and J K are congruent. A blue line connects from vertex D to vertex J. The octagon is reflected about the line where the image lies on the pre-image.

hints.content:
The symmetries that apply to the octagon are:

Symmetry | Applies to the figure?
:- | :-:
Reflective symmetry over $\overline{AF}$ | Yes
Reflective symmetry over $\overline{DJ}$ | Yes
